units.function: Pure tests for probing local, SSH, built-in sandbox, plugin sandbox-provider and plugin environment drivers, with an optional fresh runtime-lease path for a stronger sandbox check.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> environment-probe service -> mocked SSH helper, plugin worker probe and environment-runtime lease service; no real network/provider, Secret store, database, command execution, audit or node-attestation verifier is exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Environment driver/config/status, structured probe result/summary/details, company/instance context, custom-image flag and ephemeral sandbox run lease with provider metadata and cleanup status.
units.lifecycle: Select driver -> return synthetic local/fake readiness or call SSH/plugin probe -> optionally force a fresh non-reused archived sandbox lease -> report connection metadata/error -> release the acquired lease.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 7/7. It verifies driver routing, one SSH failure shape and intended fresh-lease arguments/release. It does not distinguish readiness assurance levels, run an actual sandbox command, validate plugin result schemas, or cover acquisition/probe/release failures, cancellation/timeouts, cleanup recovery, redaction, concurrency, tenant scope and attestation.
units.designRationale: Offer fast configuration checks by default while allowing an operator route to pay for a real disposable sandbox allocation when validating a saved environment and custom image.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs truthful, low-risk health/enrollment/conformance signals for execution nodes and Connectors, ranging from configuration checks to real capability exercises, without exposing tenant credentials or claiming more assurance than tested.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the tiered cheap-versus-ephemeral probe and forced non-reuse cleanup. Define explicit CONFIGURED/REACHABLE/QUALIFIED/EXECUTED assurance levels, preserve tenant/deployment principals, run a bounded conformance action, require structured redacted results, guarantee cleanup through a durable lease reconciler and emit signed evidence with capability/image/policy digests.
units.responsibilityConflict: A green probe currently does not identify who requested it, which tenant may use the node, what permissions/data were exercised or who accepts the result. Hard-coded instance scope and synthetic readiness cannot support accountable deployment enrollment.
units.securityFindings: HIGH assurance ambiguity: local/fake success and lease acquisition can be presented as ready without a verified bounded execution. HIGH tenant-scope gap: plugin probes use hard-coded instance context. HIGH error/metadata disclosure gap: SSH and plugin detail payloads lack tested classification/redaction. HIGH cleanup gap: acquisition/probe/release failure and leaked lease recovery are untested. MEDIUM responsibility gap: no requesting/accepting human, policy digest or signed evidence.
